Final prices, no hidden fees. Payments are handled by Stripe. Cancel anytime from the customer portal. EU consumers have a 14-day right of withdrawal, see the Terms.

What counts as a check

A check is one valuation: FlipLens looks up the market and calculates resale value, profit and a verdict. Recognising the item from a photo or barcode is included. Checks reset on the 1st of every month.

Questions

Is there a free plan?

Yes. Free includes 10 checks per month with photo and barcode recognition, profit and ROI, and stock tracking. No card is needed.

What do the paid plans add?

Pro (€9.99/month): 100 checks per month, stock tracking with real profit, listing generator for ebay, vinted, kleinanzeigen. Reseller (€19.99/month): unlimited checks (fair use 1,000/month), everything in pro, priority support and new features first.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Cancel in the customer portal from your profile; the plan stays active until the end of the paid month.
